description: Change a draft or a set of unpublished changes before it is published. Only the draft changes, never the live store; values given here replace the draft's earlier values (arrays replace the whole list), so check the draft first. `changes` is partial.

store.description: Which connected store (its myshopify address, e.g. other-store.myshopify.com). Leave it out for the default store; list_stores shows them.

name: edit_draft
title: Edit a draft (store not changed)
